Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

I was reading and Wider View is not written in "during x, do y". Can I use it multiple times during the same influence phase?

Many thanks in advance

Wider View
Trifle
Trifle.
Put this card in play. You can use 1 transfer to draw 1 card from your crypt and then remove a crypt card in your uncontrolled region from the game. You can use 4 transfers to burn this card and gain 2 pool.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: You can use it as many times as you have transfers, as long as there are still crypt cards left to draw.
